name: Dominica
description: Dominica, the "nature island", from the Kalinago to French and British rule, independence in 1978 and Hurricane Maria.

checkpoints.name: Kalinago and colonists
checkpoints.note: Columbus named the island in 1493, but the Kalinago held it for two centuries. France and Britain fought over it, and Britain kept it from 1763.

checkpoints.name: Independent Dominica
checkpoints.note: Dominica became independent in 1978. Hurricanes David in 1979 and Maria in 2017 devastated the island.

audio.title: Isle of Beauty, Isle of Splendour
